exclusion_policy: No outcome-driven exclusions. Provider failures, timeouts, CANNOT_CHECK, low-confidence diagnoses, and harmful mutations remain in raw records and are reported under the frozen denominator rules.

primary_hypothesis.text: At matched resources, adding responsibility diagnosability and scoped epistemic licensing reduces unnecessary or unauthorized epistemic mutation by at least 3 percentage points versus the frozen P1 V1 system while root task success is non-inferior within 2 percentage points.

resource_policy: Pair V1 and V2 on identical cases with equal model/tool/token/time ceilings; diagnostic probes consume the same tool/time budget rather than receiving free extra calls.

secondary_hypotheses.text: Active discriminators improve responsibility macro-F1 versus passive diagnosis at matched probe budget.
Information-gain-selected probes reduce diagnostic cost to the same frozen confidence threshold.
